mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_business_change_version (change_version_id, history_id, version_no, operation_type, snapshot_json, snapshot_format, create_by, create_time) VALUES (#{row.changeVersionId}, #{row.historyId}, #{row.versionNo}, #{row.operationType}, #{row.snapshotJson}, #{row.snapshotFormat}, #{row.createBy}, #{row.createTime})
mapper.select: SELECT change_version_id, history_id, version_no, operation_type, snapshot_json, snapshot_format, create_by, create_time FROM t_business_change_version WHERE history_id = #{historyId} ORDER BY version_no

SELECT change_version_id, history_id, version_no, operation_type, snapshot_json, snapshot_format, create_by, create_time FROM t_business_change_version WHERE history_id IN #{historyId} ORDER BY history_id, version_no
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_business_change_version WHERE history_id IN #{historyId}
